readinessMeaning: Mapping and authority contract ready; no production Activity or binding created.
answerCorrectnessRuntime: DEFERRED until separately authorized Activity creation/integration
privateAuthority: answer key in existing activity secret
frozenTextHandling: Do not expose whole Node7 authoring text to student or provider because it contains answers. Approved projection selects public prompt/feedback facts; private answer is not copied into manifest/cue/tool. No source-text mutation here; future content changes require revision authorization.
parentBinding: Target has no digital_textbook_nodes or activities. Future official authoring workflow must supply minimal existing activity parent and explicit Node7 mapping; no manual fake FK and no second activity schema.
r7bScope: One isolated fixture Activity first; second is later same-system configuration.
